coverage.strict_admission: Real mounted Governance propose/review/decide/revoke/exact GET/list/latest-approved; verified issuer/audience/subject/tenant/roles/finite expiry; missing claims and body/header escalation rejected; cross-tenant IDs remain private. Governance-specific auth config cannot inherit generic BFF/runtime authority.
coverage.policy: All seven existing risk-role positive pairs, including low-risk automated_gate, plus retained human-gate/MFA/distinct-actor regressions. Control-plane policy delegates to governance/write_authority.py.
coverage.atomic_durability: One PostgreSQL foundation transaction commits decision CAS, original scoped receipt and canonical audit. Two real processes compete on review and decide; original approved receipt survives discarded response, revocation and fresh process restart. Divergent keys/stale bases conflict. Audit constraint, final receipt write and deferred commit faults roll back all records and allow original command retry.
coverage.event_boundary: ApprovalDecision has no separate event-bus/outbox publisher. Its canonical audit is atomic with the decision and receipt. Deployment existing saga/outbox dispatch, lease recovery and terminal binding positives are retained; no second publisher/controller was introduced.
coverage.shared_reader: One side-effect-free exact-ID ApprovalReader and typed ApprovalEvidence. Negative validity/transport cases cover ID/tenant/target/version/digest, revoked/superseded/expired/conditional decisions, wrong risk-role, missing provenance, HTML/malformed/denied/unavailable reads, redirects and invalid configuration. Redirect credentials never reach a second URL.
coverage.registry: Real scoped JWT/HTTP Registry registration, candidate transition, exact Governance approval, atomic APPROVED transition with retained evidence and original receipt readback after fresh-process restart. Wrong target/version/digest/tenant, conditional/expired/revoked/missing decisions leave the candidate byte-for-byte unchanged.
coverage.deployment_runtime: The transferred full dispatcher proof uses real Governance/Registry PostgreSQL HTTP owners, actual Deployment FastAPI routes/stores, actual worker verification and Runtime Flask deploy route with strict synthetic JWT/MFA claims. Runtime re-verifies owner references at its write boundary; terminal plan/saga/outbox/binding/capital-readback assertions remain. A second plan admitted before revoke is then rejected by Runtime authority and Deployment dispatch without new outbox events; new plan creation also rejects.
coverage.persona: The real Persona HttpGovernanceApprovalVerifier reads mounted Governance and verifies exact decision reference, persona/tenant, generation version, session and candidate/proof digests; all swapped predicates and later revocation reject. Existing training-target owner persistence/recovery/replay tests also pass.
coverage.retirement: Deployment request-supplied Registry/approval objects and dispatch Registry blobs are rejected. Local Registry/ApprovalDecision JSON selectors and projection reads are removed. Registry caller approver is rejected; verified actor/evidence is retained. Existing generic worker callbacks no longer substitute for scoped Registry/Governance reads.
coverage.contracts: Governance, Registry and Deployment contracts plus schemas/first-release contract and Compose settings document exact principal/API/DTO/base/version/digest/readback configuration for the existing Overlay owner.
